to: The epic worktrail — the tool still carries the tool's former name

The epic becomes 'branchling — the tool': the product name is substituted and the grouping is left exactly as it was. An epic is a live index key that stats and the boards read today, not a sentence recording what happened, so rewriting it on an archived task asserts nothing about the past — which is why all ten carriers being closed does not block this.
